eligible_conditions: Competent and alert at the time of counseling
Counseling furnished by a qualified primary care physician or other primary care practitioner in a primary care setting
exclusions: Beneficiaries who do not achieve a reduction of at least 3 kg during the first 6 months (no additional sessions beyond 12 months)
Services provided outside a primary care setting
Services provided by non-qualified primary care practitioners
citations: NCD 210.12 - Intensive Behavioral Therapy for Obesity
U.S. Preventive Services Task Force (USPSTF) Grade B recommendation for obesity screening
